title: AI Engineer / Software Engineer (all genders)

Wir gehören zu den Top\-Adressen in der IT\-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. * Konzeption und Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in den Bereichen Konzeption, Entwicklung und Design von Java\- und AI\-Anwendungen in einem agilen Projektumfeld.
* Konzipiere Microservice\-Architekturen: Du konzipierst und realisierst moderne Microservice\-Architekturen und verteilte Systeme in vollem Umfang.
* Projektbegleitung: Von der Idee bis zum Go\-live begleitest du die Lösungen sorgfältig.


**DEIN PROFIL**
* Starker Hintergrund: Du bringst einen starken Hintergrund in Java\-Backend\-Entwicklung, AI\-Programmierung und Software\-Engineering mit.
* Java\-Backendentwicklung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Java\-Backendentwicklung webbasierter, skalierbarer Systeme und Anwendungen mit verschiedenen Datenbanken und Frameworks (z.B. Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate) in einem agilen Projektumfeld helfen dir, alle Herausforderungen zu meistern. Du hast Spaß daran, Kunden durch die digitale Transformation in hochmoderne Prozesse zu führen.
* AI\-Programmierung: Praktische Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von AI\-Anwendungsfällen mit verschiedenen Frameworks bringst du ebenfalls mit.

* Sprachkenntnisse: Für deine Tätigkeit benötigst du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1\-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir\-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1\. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. title: Senior AI Engineer Embedded Systems (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Du möchtest moderne Computer\-Vision\-Technologien dort einsetzen, wo sie den größten Mehrwert schaffen? nämlich direkt auf Edge\- und Embedded\-Geräten in industriellen Umgebungen. Dann wirst du dich in unserem AI \& Engineering Team bei CGI sehr gut aufgehoben fühlen. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Lösungen, die die Leistungsfähigkeit von Produktionssystemen, Maschinen und autonomen Anwendungen deutlich steigern und unter realen Bedingungen zuverlässig funktionieren.
   

  

 Als Senior AI Engineer Embedded Systems verantwortest du die Entwicklung und Optimierung von KI\-Modellen, die auf ressourcenbegrenzter Hardware performant ausgeführt werden. Du arbeitest an robusten Computer\-Vision\-Pipelines, die in Bereichen wie Fertigung, Robotik, Automotive oder Logistik eingesetzt werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Embedded\-Entwicklerinnen und \-Entwicklern sowie Expertinnen und Experten aus verschiedenen Branchen zusammen. Du triffst fundierte technische Entscheidungen, gestaltest Architekturen und Standards aktiv mit und setzt technologische Maßstäbe.
   

  

 CGI bietet dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigenverantwortung, technische Exzellenz und Teamkultur einen hohen Stellenwert haben. Du arbeitest mit modernsten Technologien, entwickelst anspruchsvolle Lösungen und siehst die direkte Wirkung deiner Arbeit in realen industriellen Anwendungen.
   

  

 Aufgaben
   

  

 In dieser Rolle entwickelst du moderne Computer\-Vision\-Modelle für den Betrieb auf Embedded\- und Edge\-Systemen. Du stellst sicher, dass diese Modelle unter realen Bedingungen stabil, performant und zuverlässig arbeiten. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die algorithmische Seite als auch hardwarenahe Aspekte und die vollständige Integration in industrielle Umgebungen.
   

  

 Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:
   

  

* Du bist zuständig für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Computer\-Vision\-Modellen für Embedded\- und Edge\-Plattformen wie NVIDIA Jetson, ARM\-Systeme oder Intel Movidius.
* Du implementierst performante Inferenzpipelines in C\+\+ und Python unter Nutzung von Frameworks wie GStreamer, OpenCV oder CUDA.
* Du übernimmst die Durchführung von Modelloptimierungen wie Quantisierung, Pruning und Knowledge Distillation sowie die Verwendung von Frameworks wie TensorRT oder ONNX Runtime.
* Zusätzlich bist du verantwortlich für die Analyse und Integration verschiedener Sensortypen wie RGB\-, Tiefen\-, Thermal\- oder Time\-of\-Flight\-Kameras in robuste CV\- und ML\-Pipelines.
* Du pflegst eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit AI\- und Produktteams beim Design und Deployment von Modellen auf Edge\-Geräten, einschließlich Monitoring, Logging und Over\-the\-Air\-Update\-Konzepten.
* Zudem zählen die Mitgestaltung leistungsfähiger Edge\-Cloud\-Architekturen sowie die technische Beratung von Kundinnen und Kunden bei der Umsetzung ihrer Anforderungen zu deinen Aufgaben.


 Qualifikation
   

  

 Du verfügst über die Seniorität, technische Tiefe und praktische Erfahrung, um KI\-Modelle auf Embedded\-Hardware so zu entwickeln, dass sie zu einem verlässlichen Bestandteil industrieller Systeme werden. Du kombinierst fundiertes Wissen über moderne Computer\-Vision\-Verfahren mit einem tiefen Verständnis für hardwarenahe Entwicklung und Echtzeitbedingungen.
   

  

 Was du mitbringen solltest:
   

  

* Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Computer Vision, Embedded AI oder der Implementierung von ML\-Modellen in Edge\-Umgebungen.
* Du bringst ein tiefes Verständnis moderner CV\-Architekturen wie CNNs, EfficientNet, YOLO oder Vision Transformers sowie Erfahrung mit Modelloptimierungen wie Quantisierung, Pruning oder Knowledge Distillation mit.
* Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in C\+\+ für performante und hardwarenahe Implementierungen sowie in Python für Prototyping und ML\-Workflows.
* Zudem hast du Erfahrung mit Embedded\- und Edge\-Plattformen wie NVIDIA Jetson, ARM\-Systemen, IntelMovidius/OpenVINO oder Google Coral gesammelt.
* Du weist Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Tools wie GStreamer, OpenCV, V4L2, libcamera, CUDA oder cuDNN auf.
* Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau produktionsreifer Edge\-AI\-Pipelines einschließlich Containerisierung, Telemetrie, OTA\-Updates und Device\-Monitoring.
* Du hast eine strukturierte und überzeugende Kommunikationsweise, mit der du technische Entscheidungen klar erklärst und sowohl Kundinnen und Kunden als auch interne Teams professionell beraten kannst.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.


 Was wir bieten:
   

  

* Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos.
* Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work\-Life\-Balance am Herzen liegt.
* Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten.

* Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu.

Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen\- und Technologie\-Kompetenz zu profitieren.

 Seit 1998 macht LichtBlick sich für erneuerbare Energien stark. Heute sind wir mit über 1,7 Millionen LichtBlickenden Deutschlands größter reiner Ökostromanbieter. Gemeinsam sparen wir eine Mio. Als Unterzeichnerin der Charta der Vielfalt arbeiten wir aktiv an unserer Haltung, unseren Strukturen und unserem Miteinander. Dabei verfolgen wir nachhaltig das Ziel, Diskriminierung ab\- und Chancengleichheit für alle Bewerber\*innen und Mitarbeiter\*innen aufzubauen. Du bist also herzlich willkommen, unser Team bunter und die Zukunft grüner zu machen.
   

  

 LichtBlick sucht dich. Ab sofort. In Teil\- oder Vollzeit und unbefristet. Für gute Energie im Bereich Technology.
   

  

**Dein Job**
* Du entwirfst und implementierst Agentic\-AI\-Anwendungen mit Microsoft Foundry und integrierst sie in eine bestehende Landschaft von Backend\- und Frontend\-Services

* Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung mit .NET/C\# oder Python in Kombination mit Azure
* Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Foundry und Agent\-/RAG\-Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework oder LangChain/LangGraph
* Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Prompt\- und Context Engineering sowie in der Bewertung von Antwortqualität, Grounding, Latenz und Kosten

* Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität und ein Herz für Nachhaltigkeit
* Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil


**Benefits**
* Flexible Arbeits­gestaltung (u.a. Flex time, Überstundenausgleich, mobiles Arbeiten deutschlandweit)
* Modernste Arbeitsausstattung ist bei uns selbstverständlich
* Ein modernes Loft\-Büro direkt am Hamburger Hauptbahnhof
* Eine faire, trans­parente Gehalts\- und Karriere­entwicklung
* Vielfältige Weiter­entwicklung­smöglich­keiten (u.a. LichtBlick Learning, Leadership Lab)
* Mobilitätszuschlag (Bike\-Leasing oder Deutschlandticket)
* Bezuschussung betriebliche Alters­vorsorge und Berufs­unfähig­keits­ver­sicherung
* Kita\-Zuschuss pro Monat pro Kind
* Anteilige Kostenübernahme für deinen LichtBlick\-Ökostrom\-Tarif
* Die Option auf ein dreimonatiges Sabbatical
* Kostenfreie Nutzung des internen Fitnessstudios und Bezuschussung der Bäderlandkarte
* St.Pauli Loge im Millerntor: Workshops, Spielbesuche und mehr
* Benefits Pass von Pluxee und Corporate Benefits


**Unser Bewerbungsprozess \& Dein Kontakt**
 Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist für dich transparent und offen gestaltet. Wir prüfen deine eingegangen Bewerbungsunterlagen sorgfältig und geben dir schnellstmöglich Feedback. Im ersten lockeren Austausch lernst du deine Ansprechpartner\*innen (Recruitment und Fachbereich) remote kennen. Wir zeigen dir unsere gelebte Unternehmenskultur auf, was LichtBlick ausmacht und welches Mindset wir leben. Gerne beantworten wir deine Fragen gemeinsam. Dein Zweitgespräch findet persönlich und somit gerne in unserem Office statt. Hier kannst du unsere Arbeitsumgebung kennenlernen und dich mit zukünftigen Kolleg\*innen austauschen, denn für uns ist auch entscheidend, ob es persönlich "klickt". Alle sind sich einig? title: Agentic Engineer
description:
I am working for a company operating at the core of the fitness and gym technology space across DACH and Europe.
 



  





 They provide the ERP and payments backbone behind major platforms used by gyms and fitness operators, and are now building a dedicated AI and automation capability to reshape how internal work gets done.
 



  





 This role is for an Agentic Engineer, based in Hamburg or remote across DACH and the EU.
 



 It is a hands\-on building role. The focus is not research or tooling exploration, but shipping working agents that are used internally, iterated quickly, and retired when they no longer add value.
 



  





 You would sit within a structured AI stack, working alongside an AI Systems Lead and Solutions Engineering function, and focus on designing and delivering the actual agents themselves.
 



  





 What you would own
 



 • Designing and shipping agents end to end
 



 Define agent scope, behaviour and user experience
 



 Design memory, tools, workflows and failure handling
 



 Take agents from idea to production and iterate based on real usage
 



  





 • Fast build and iteration cycles
 



 Work in two to four week cycles with real internal users
 



 Ship early, gather feedback, refine or retire quickly
 



 Maintain an internal catalogue of active agents
 



  





 • Working within a defined AI architecture
 



 Use established reference patterns set by the AI Systems Lead
 



 Build on top of shared data infrastructure and internal tooling
 



 Focus on agent design quality rather than infrastructure ownership
 



  






 What they are looking for
 




 • Around two to four years of software engineering experience
 



 • Strong Python skills
 



 • Deep hands\-on experience with the Claude ecosystem (non\-negotiable)
 



 Including Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, tool use, MCP servers, sub\-agents, skills and Cowork
 



 • Exposure to other agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen is a plus
 



 • Evidence of building and shipping working AI agents, ideally in side projects or portfolios
 



 • Strong bias towards building rather than theorising
 



 • Interest in how AI tools improve real day\-to\-day work for non\-technical users
 



  






 Additional details
 




 • Junior to mid level role
 



 • Full time
 



 • Hamburg or remote across DACH / EU
 



 • Small, high ownership environment with fast iteration cycles
 



 • Open to strong graduates or career switchers with proven hands\-on agent building work
 



 • Fluent English required, German is a plus
 



 • Legal right to work in Germany required

title: AI Trace Generation Engineer
description:
Your mission
   

  

 To support our growing team, we are looking for an experienced AI Trace Generation Engineer to join us. In this role, you will take both a strategic and hands\-on approach to designing and building systems that enable deep visibility into distributed AI workloads. This includes developing trace collection, instrumentation, and simulation capabilities that help optimize performance across large\-scale, multi\-GPU environments. You will work at the intersection of machine learning and systems engineering, contributing to the core infrastructure powering next\-generation AI workloads.
   

  

**Your mission**
* Design and implement a trace collection system for distributed LLM workloads, capturing compute operations, communication primitives, memory usage, and cluster topology across multi\-GPU and multi\-node setups
* Validate that collected traces accurately reflect real workload behavior \- verifying operation completeness, timing consistency, and data integrity across inference and training pipelines
* Integrate with and instrument major LLM frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, DeepSpeed, Megatron\-LM and others) to extract meaningful execution data without disrupting performance
* Use collected traces as input to discrete event simulations that model and replay distributed AI workload behavior at scale
* Analyze trace data to surface bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the stack, from individual kernel execution to cluster\-wide communication patterns


 Your profile
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in AI systems, ML infrastructure, or a closely related area
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major LLM serving or training framework
* Strong proficiency in Python and C\+\+, with a solid understanding of GPU architecture, memory bandwidth, and the difference between compute\-bound and memory\-bound operations
* Solid understanding of distributed communication
* Familiarity with parallelism strategies and how they shape execution behavior across large clusters


**Nice to have**
* Open source contributions or published research in relevant areas
* Experience in startup environments, with the ability to move quickly, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership


 Why us?
   

  

* Build something big: Help build and scale a fast\-growing AI infrastructure startup
* Pay \& perks: Competitive compensation with a performance\-based incentive, subsidized Deutschlandticket, and access to a discount portal
* Work your way: Flexible hours with hybrid and remote\-friendly options
* Fast lanes, no red tape: Flat hierarchies and rapid decision\-making mean ideas ship quickly
* Global team: Work with a diverse, international team across Germany and the USA
* Modern headquarters: Well\-stocked office near the Heidelberg Hauptbahnhof, available on a hybrid basis or as a place to connect during our quarterly team workshops
* Top setup: Your choice of high\-quality hardware and equipment
* Relocation support: We’ll help make your move to join us as smooth as possible


**About Us**
 turbalance is an innovative, emerging startup that transforms AI laws. We are a team of passionate problem\-solvers who believe in what we’re building. We constantly push boundaries and embrace our inner nerds as we find new ways to tackle complex challenges. You will find a dynamic work environment here, with flat or even non\-existent hierarchies and the chance to take on responsibility from day one.

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.


Behind the user\-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.


**About the role**
------------------



AI is changing how product and engineering teams operate, and we're building the team that defines what that looks like at Fever.



Your scope is the AI substrate that makes both engineering and product workflows faster, higher\-quality, and more leveraged at Fever. You'll lead a team, partner with peers across engineering and product, and report to the Head of Engineering, AI \& DevEx.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


* **Your team**. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI engineers.
* **The metrics the team is accountable to**. Lead time ideashipped, cost per shipped feature, harness shippable\-output rate, human intervention rate. Make the work answerable to numbers.
* **The agentic harness for product and engineering** — the skills, sub\-agents, guardrails, and verification that make agents produce shippable output, not suggestive output, across the whole software lifecycle. Plus the shared knowledge\-base infrastructure these agents read from and write into. You own how good it is and how widely it's adopted.
* **Evaluation infrastructure**. A measurement substrate that lets every harness change land on signal, not vibes. The discipline of naked baselines and "ship only on a measured improvement" is non\-negotiable.
* **Inference economics**. Bound the cost of every AI\-driven workflow at Fever. Decide model routing, caching strategy, and when self\-hosted open\-source wins versus frontier models on the joint quality \+ cost frontier.

**About you**

* **You're an AI Engineer**. You build on top of foundation models — prompt engineering, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation, fine\-tuning when it's the right tool — and you ship those systems to production. **Qualifications**

* RAG Architecture: Understanding how to build and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation systems, including indexing, retrieval, and re\-ranking.
* Python: Basic knowledge for working with data science scripts or AI evaluation libraries.

* Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.

Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. description:
#### **What we do**


Merantix Capital is an early\-stage AI investor backing ambitious AI founders across Europe. Our roots lie in the Merantix Venture Studio, where we have supported and built AI\-native companies since 2016 \- from idea validation and co\-founder matching to first customers, team building and follow\-on financing. Today, we combine this company\-building DNA with a dedicated early\-stage AI fund, investing in pre\-seed AI companies across Europe.


We are part of the Merantix Group, one of Europe’s leading AI platforms, including the AI Campus in Berlin, London AI Hub, Merantix Momentum, AI House Davos and a network of founders, engineers, industry partners, investors and AI experts. Our ambition is to be more than a capital provider: we help founders access customers, attract talent, sharpen product and go\-to\-market strategy, prepare for follow\-on financing and scale AI companies from the earliest stages.

#### **Your role**


We are looking for a technically strong investor to join Merantix Capital and focus on direct investments.


You will work with the investment team to identify, evaluate and invest in AI founders across Europe. The role spans the full investment process: sourcing, thesis development, technical and commercial due diligence, investment committee preparation, deal execution and portfolio support.


A core part of the role is forming a view on whether an AI company is not only commercially attractive, but also technically credible: whether the product works, whether the data or model approach is defensible, whether the system can scale, and whether the team can execute.

  

Your responsibilities will include:

* Sourcing exceptional pre\-seed founders and investment opportunities across Europe’s AI ecosystem
* Developing original investment themes in AI based on market research, founder conversations, customer feedback and technology shifts
* Evaluating new investment opportunities across team, product, market, technology, competition, business model, GTM and financing dynamics
* Leading due diligence processes, including market sizing, competitive mapping, customer calls, technical assessment and financial analysis
* Preparing high\-quality investment materials and recommendations for internal discussions and investment committee decisions
* Building strong relationships with founders, angels, VCs, operators, accelerators, universities and AI research communities
* Supporting portfolio companies on strategic topics such as fundraising, hiring, customer introductions, positioning and GTM
* Leveraging the Merantix ecosystem to support portfolio companies and strengthen our position as a leading European AI investment platform

#### **Your profile**

### **Required:**

* Strong technical background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, data science, engineering or a related field
* Prior experience in VC, early\-stage investing, angel investing or technical due diligence
* Strong network in the European AI, software, research or startup ecosystem
* Strong understanding of modern AI/ML systems, including model development, data pipelines, deployment, evaluation and production constraints
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to quickly understand new markets, products, technologies and business models
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to assess venture\-scale potential
* Clear written communication and ability to prepare investment memos and recommendations
* High ownership and ability to manage several processes in parallel

### **Strong plus:**

* Prior founder, startup or hands\-on experience building, shipping or scaling technical products, ideally in AI/ML, data, software or infrastructure
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related technical field
* Domain expertise in Industrial AI, Healthcare, Robotics, FinTech, Cybersecurity, Developer Tools, Enterprise Software or AI Infrastructure

#### **What we offer**


We offer attractive compensation, including carry in our AI fund, and a high\-ownership role at the intersection of AI, venture capital and company building. You will work closely with founders from the earliest stages through financing and scaling, while benefiting from the broader Merantix ecosystem of founders, AI engineers, operators, industry partners, investors and the AI Campus.  

  

At Merantix, we value ownership, intellectual honesty, low ego and high ambition. You will be encouraged to develop your own investment themes, build strong founder relationships, make independent investment recommendations and help us back the next generation of European AI companies.  

Due to the volume of applications we receive, warm introductions are helpful but not required. We review all applications carefully.

#### **About us**


We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity. We consider all applications equally regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply.

description:
**AI \& Machine Learning Engineer \- AI Training**
--------------------------------------------------


#### ***About Prolific***



Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.



Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


#### ***The role***



We're looking for **AI and Machine Learning Engineers** to join our Expert Network to help train and evaluate the next generation of LLMs using deep technical expertise. If you have the necessary experience, we'll send you a quick 10\- to 15\-minute test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you'll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you'll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.



Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay up to **$80 per hour**. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


#### ***What you'll bring***


* **Education:** a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with a focus on Machine Learning.
* **Professional Experience:** experience building, deploying, or fine\-tuning ML models in a production environment.
* **Deep Learning Mastery:** professional\-level understanding of neural network architectures (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs) and optimization techniques.
* **LLM Specialization:** hands\-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), or RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) workflows.
* **Technical Rigor:** the ability to audit complex model logic, identify training data contamination, and evaluate mathematical proofs behind ML algorithms.
* **Analytical Critique:** high attention to detail in spotting "hallucinations," biased outputs, or logical failures in AI\-generated technical content.

  


#### ***What you'll be doing in the role***


* **Evaluate LLM Architecture Logic:** review AI\-generated explanations of model architectures, loss functions, and backpropagation for technical accuracy.
* **Audit Code \& Notebooks:** validate ML\-specific code (e.g., training loops, data preprocessing scripts, or model evaluations) for efficiency and correctness.
* **Refine RLHF Frameworks:** provide the high\-quality human feedback necessary to align models with human intent, safety, and helpfulness.
* **Analyze Model Reasoning:** critically assess how an AI model navigates complex chain\-of\-thought (CoT) prompts and identify where the reasoning breaks down.
* **Benchmark Performance:** conduct comparative testing between different model outputs based on specific technical taxonomies and performance metrics.

  


#### ***Key Technologies***


* **Frameworks:** expert proficiency in **PyTorch** or **TensorFlow/Keras**.
* **Language \& Data:** advanced **Python** (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit\-learn) and experience with Hugging Face Transformers.
* **Cloud \& MLOps:** experience with AWS (SageMaker), Google Cloud (Vertex AI), or specialized tools like Weights \& Biases and LangChain.
* **Vector Databases:** familiarity with Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate for RAG evaluation.

#### ***Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant***



Joining our Expert Network will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.



We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high\-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.



We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

* **Benchmark Performance:** conduct comparative testing between different model outputs based on specific technical taxonomies and performance metrics.

**Role Requirements**

* Practical experience deploying AI models into production environments, not just experimentation or notebooks.
* Familiarity with behavioural modelling concepts such as imitation learning, behavioural cloning, or decision‑process modelling.
* Working experience with causal inference tooling or methodologies (e.g. DoWhy, EconML, CausalML) applied to real data.
* Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience building or integrating AI systems using APIs, services, pipelines, or orchestration frameworks.
* Comfortable collaborating in engineering‑led product environments, balancing research insight with delivery constraints.

 You will have significant technical ownership — this is not a role for someone who wants to configure existing frameworks. We are looking for someone who can design novel solutions to hard problems and take them all the way to production.
   

  

**What you can expect to be doing:**
**Architecture \& Technical Design**
* Work closely with the Head of AI to contribute to and implement the technical architecture of Chip's multi\-agent AI systems — from orchestration layer to inter\-agent communication and context persistence
* Design bespoke frameworks and tooling where off\-the\-shelf solutions fall short
* Author and maintain architectural decision records (ADRs) and engineering standards for the AI chapter
* Evaluate emerging techniques and approaches, adapting from research into production\-ready implementations


**Delivery \& Implementation**
* Lead the hands\-on implementation of AI systems alongside the team, maintaining deep technical involvement
* Build production\-grade systems: observable, reliable, and cost\-efficient at scale across Chip's 400k\+ user base
* Define and implement testing and evaluation strategies for agentic systems — models\-as\-judge, synthetic data, human\-in\-the\-loop processes and runtime safety / quality controls
* Identify and implement “flywheels” and process that drive quality and performance through continuous iterative improvements
* Own the integration of AI systems with Chip's existing infrastructure, including async patterns and SDK design


**Technical Leadership**
* Set the technical bar for AI engineering at Chip — reviewing work, raising standards, and mentoring engineers
* Work closely with the Head of AI on technical strategy and architectural direction
* Partner with the AI Product Manager and wider engineering teams on technically complex initiatives
* Contribute to Chip's company\-wide AI engineering standards and governance

* Deep hands\-on experience designing and building multi\-agent AI systems in production — not just configuring existing frameworks
* Proven ability to take AI systems from concept through to production with long\-term ownership
* Track record of solving hard technical problems: large context windows, hallucination mitigation, novel orchestration patterns
* Experience building customer\-facing AI systems in regulated, high\-trust, or high\-risk domains is a strong plus.
* Experience building AI systems on AWS is strongly preferred, particularly using services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, ECS, and EventBridge.

* Strong experience with evaluation frameworks, retrieval systems, model behaviour analysis and production observability for AI systems

**This isn’t a job description. It’s your invitation.** 




  





 At Aventum Group, we don’t hire to fill seats. We bring people in to build something real.
 



  





 We want people to join us (that person might be you) on our mission to be the world’s most inspiring insurance group, not by playing it safe but by delivering the unexpected and creating meaningful impact. That means backing ideas early, trusting people to own their work and giving them the space to grow faster than they thought possible.
 



  





 If you’re looking for rigid career paths or a one\-size\-fits\-all management, Aventum Group probably isn’t for you. However, if you
 **do** 
 want responsibility from day one, honest feedback and a culture that expects you to speak up, take ownership and keep getting better, then you might just be a great fit.
 



  





 Some people join us knowing exactly where they want to go. Others figure it out once they’re here. Both work here \- the question is, will you?
 



  





**What You’ll Take On (The Actual Job Description)** 




  





 So you’re looking for a new challenge? This is your chance to step into a role with real responsibility. You’ll be given the space to own your work, supported to move as fast as you want and expected to keep raising the bar for yourself and the business.
 



  





 AI Engineer – Behavioural \& Decision Systems.
 
 This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who wants their models to matter. You’ll take advanced behavioural and decision‑based AI and turn it into production systems that sit at the core of live digital products. Your work will shape how our platforms predict behaviour, make decisions and adapt in real time, powering Digital Twins, agentic systems and intelligent automation across the business. You’ll operate at the point where modelling meets delivery, with real ownership from data through to live impact.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Turn behavioural and sequential models into production‑grade systems that directly influence real decisions and outcomes.
* Own end‑to‑end AI pipelines, from raw data to monitored, reliable inference in live products.
* Embed causal thinking into how we evaluate impact, helping teams understand what actually changes behaviour and why.
* Build AI services that integrate cleanly into existing platforms, shaping APIs, events and decision flows alongside engineers.
* Bring behavioural dynamics to life in Digital Twins and agentic systems, making complex decision processes observable and actionable.



  





 This role is built for someone who backs themselves, takes ownership and wants to see their work used not parked in notebooks. If you’re motivated by pace, accountability and the chance to build systems that genuinely change how products behave, you’ll feel at home here.
 



  





**What it’s Like to Work Here** 




 Expect high standards \- and the support to meet them. Expect autonomy (not micromanagement) and the chance to collaborate across teams, brands and borders. Here, your ideas are taken seriously, wherever you sit in the business.
 



  





 We invest when the right tools don’t exist. We listen when our people say something can be better. And when we win, we make sure the people building the business win too. This is a place where performance matters \- but so does enjoyment, curiosity and doing work you are proud of.
 



  





**Who Thrives at Aventum Group?** 




 We don’t expect you to tick every box. Experience helps, but curiosity matters more. If you are willing to learn, take ownership and ask questions when you don’t know the answer, you’re already off to a great start. We look for people who:
 



  




* Have experience relevant to the role, whether from a similar position, education or transferable skills
* Confidence in communicating with others and working together
* A mindset focused on learning, improvement and follow\-through
* An interest in how things work (and how they could be improved)



  





 If this sounds like you, you sound ready for a new chapter of challenge at Aventum Group.
 



  





**Why Apply** 




 Because you want more than a job title. Because you want to grow, not wait your turn. Because you want to be trusted to do good work (and get recognised when you do it). And because you want to help build something inspiring, unexpected and meaningful.
 



  





 So… challenge accepted?

description:

**REPORTS TO: DIRECTOR OF INNOVATION** 




**COMPANY:
 
 STEVEN.COM**




**LOCATION: LONDON, UK** 




  





**COMPANY CONTEXT** 





 Steven.com
 
 is the operating system for the creator economy. As influence shifts from legacy institutions to trusted individuals, the creator economy has become a trillion\-dollar frontier. However, this industry is currently held back by fragmented tools and a lack of professional infrastructure.
 
 Steven.com
 
 is the unlock. We are the end\-to\-end Operating System designed to scale what is irreplaceably human. Our mission is to build the definitive platform that empowers the most trusted individuals, creators, to shape culture and build enduring enterprise value.
 



 We have built proprietary technology and obsessed teams to identify and scale the highest\-potential creators across our core pillars: Creator Media, Creator Community, Creator Products, and Creator Tech \& Intelligence. Every creator functions as a distinct, high\-performance business unit. We provide the infrastructure, roadmap, and commercial objectives to accelerate their core business while capturing growth opportunities across the entire flywheel.
 



  





**THE MISSION** 




 The Junior AI Engineer will support the building, testing, and scaling of AI\-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that drive innovation across
 
 Steven.com
 
 .
 



 Working within StudioSteven, this role will prototype and operate AI systems that solve real problems for creative, operational, and strategic teams, turning emerging tools into working systems the company can actually use.
 



 This is a hands\-on, fast\-moving role for someone ambitious, curious, and confident enough to operate independently from day one. StudioSteven moves quickly and holds itself to a high bar, you will be trusted with real work early, and expected to figure things out, ask sharp questions, and ship. The Junior AI Engineer will help build prototypes, maintain working pipelines, and grow into the technical backbone of the team's disruptive innovation work.
 



  





**KEY OUTCOMES** 



* Build and maintain AI\-powered prototypes, tools, and pipelines that support the team's work, taking ownership of what you ship.
* Operate and improve internal AI workflows, including LLM\-based systems, MCP servers, and Claude Code\-style templating environments.
* Work alongside the wider innovation teams to take prototypes from rough concept to working system, holding your own in technical conversations.
* Document pipelines, code, and workflows clearly enough that others can operate, maintain, and build on them.
* Stay plugged into emerging AI tooling, researching new models, frameworks, and approaches that could change how the team builds.



  





**CORE COMPETENCIES** 



* **Engineering Fundamentals**
* Writes code (Python or JavaScript preferred), uses version control properly, understands deployment basics, and can read and extend code written by others without hand\-holding.
* **AI Tooling Fluency**
* Comfortable working with LLM\-based workflows, Claude Code, MCP servers, or equivalent tooling. Not a deep AI researcher, but understands how these systems work and can operate them confidently.
* **Independent Operator**
* Takes ownership of problems, makes a call when one needs to be made, and pushes work forward without waiting to be told. Knows when to ask and when to figure it out, whilst communicating throughout.
* **Experimental Thinking**
* Comfortable testing, iterating, and learning from both success and failure. Knows when something is good enough to ship and when it needs more work.
* **Data Literacy**
* Can work with structured data, understand how it flows between systems, and spot when something has broken upstream.
* **Collaboration \& Communication**
* Works effectively with technical and non\-technical teammates, documents as they go, and explains technical decisions clearly.
* **Adaptability**
* Thrives in a fast\-moving environment where the tooling changes monthly, the bar is high, and the work is genuinely interesting because of it.



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* **Ideal Background**
* Has built things, side projects, internships or early\-career work where you've shipped code that other people used. You don't need years of production experience, but you need evidence that you can take something from idea to working system on your own. Comfortable in a codebase, comfortable in a terminal, comfortable researching what you don't know. You've already been building with LLMs, agents, or AI tooling in your own time, the people who do this for fun tend to be the ones who do it well.
* **How You Think**
* You learn by building. You'd rather ship a rough prototype on Tuesday and improve it on Thursday than spend a week planning the perfect version. You're ambitious about your craft, you want to be genuinely good, not just competent, and you're drawn to environments where the people around you push you to be better. You understand that AI tooling moves fast and that what you know today will be partially obsolete in six months, and that's the fun of it. You ask questions when you're stuck rather than spinning, and you document as you go because you know future\-you will thank present\-you. You treat "I don't know yet" as a starting point, not an ending one.
* **Who You Are**
* A builder first. You're energised by making things work, not by talking about making things work. Curious by default. You follow what's happening in AI tooling because you find it genuinely interesting, not because someone told you to. Confident without being precious, you'll defend a technical decision when you believe in it and change your mind when someone makes a better case. Direct and clear. You can explain what you've built to someone non\-technical without making them feel stupid, and you can flag when something isn't going to work without sugarcoating it. Low ego, high standards. You want feedback on your code, you want to work with people better than you, and you want the team to be sharper because you're on it.

#### ***About Prolific***



Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.



Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay up to **$80 per hour**. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.

* **Education:** a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with a focus on Machine Learning.

* **Deep Learning Mastery:** professional\-level understanding of neural network architectures (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs) and optimization techniques.

* **Analytical Critique:** high attention to detail in spotting "hallucinations," biased outputs, or logical failures in AI\-generated technical content.

* **Evaluate LLM Architecture Logic:** review AI\-generated explanations of model architectures, loss functions, and backpropagation for technical accuracy.
* **Audit Code \& Notebooks:** validate ML\-specific code (e.g., training loops, data preprocessing scripts, or model evaluations) for efficiency and correctness.
* **Refine RLHF Frameworks:** provide the high\-quality human feedback necessary to align models with human intent, safety, and helpfulness.
* **Analyze Model Reasoning:** critically assess how an AI model navigates complex chain\-of\-thought (CoT) prompts and identify where the reasoning breaks down.
* **Benchmark Performance:** conduct comparative testing between different model outputs based on specific technical taxonomies and performance metrics.

* **Frameworks:** expert proficiency in **PyTorch** or **TensorFlow/Keras**.

Joining our Expert Network will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.



We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high\-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

**AI \& Machine Learning Engineer \- AI Training**
--------------------------------------------------


#### ***About Prolific***



Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.



Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


#### ***The role***



We're looking for **AI and Machine Learning Engineers** to join our Expert Network to help train and evaluate the next generation of LLMs using deep technical expertise. If you have the necessary experience, we'll send you a quick 10\- to 15\-minute test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you'll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you'll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.



Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay up to **$80 per hour**. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


#### ***What you'll bring***


* **Education:** a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or a related quantitative field with a focus on Machine Learning.
* **Professional Experience:** experience building, deploying, or fine\-tuning ML models in a production environment.
* **Deep Learning Mastery:** professional\-level understanding of neural network architectures (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs) and optimization techniques.
* **LLM Specialization:** hands\-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), or RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) workflows.
* **Technical Rigor:** the ability to audit complex model logic, identify training data contamination, and evaluate mathematical proofs behind ML algorithms.
* **Analytical Critique:** high attention to detail in spotting "hallucinations," biased outputs, or logical failures in AI\-generated technical content.

  


#### ***What you'll be doing in the role***


* **Evaluate LLM Architecture Logic:** review AI\-generated explanations of model architectures, loss functions, and backpropagation for technical accuracy.
* **Audit Code \& Notebooks:** validate ML\-specific code (e.g., training loops, data preprocessing scripts, or model evaluations) for efficiency and correctness.
* **Refine RLHF Frameworks:** provide the high\-quality human feedback necessary to align models with human intent, safety, and helpfulness.
* **Analyze Model Reasoning:** critically assess how an AI model navigates complex chain\-of\-thought (CoT) prompts and identify where the reasoning breaks down.
* **Benchmark Performance:** conduct comparative testing between different model outputs based on specific technical taxonomies and performance metrics.

  


#### ***Key Technologies***


* **Frameworks:** expert proficiency in **PyTorch** or **TensorFlow/Keras**.
* **Language \& Data:** advanced **Python** (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit\-learn) and experience with Hugging Face Transformers.
* **Cloud \& MLOps:** experience with AWS (SageMaker), Google Cloud (Vertex AI), or specialized tools like Weights \& Biases and LangChain.
* **Vector Databases:** familiarity with Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate for RAG evaluation.

#### ***Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant***



Joining our Expert Network will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.



We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high\-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.



We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

R\&D Engineer — AI Video Pipeline (Student Role)
 



**Dark Half Inc. \| Toronto \| Full\-time PAID, fixed\-term \| NRC\-IRAP supported** 




  





  





 About the role
 



 Dark Half is building the commercial production pipeline for AI\-generated VFX and content. Under our current NRC\-IRAP grant, we're developing an agentic, end\-to\-end production system that takes a script or prompt and produces a finished video — running entirely on local hardware.
 



 This is a hands\-on R\&D engineering role for a recent grad or graduating student. You'll work directly under our Technical Director on the build\-out of that pipeline, doing real engineering work on real production problems. You'll be writing Python, running open\-weight video models on a Blackwell 6000, evaluating new models as they release, and helping us figure out what's actually possible at the frontier.
 



 This isn't a "fetch the coffee" internship. You'll ship code that goes into production.
 



  





 Who this is for
 



 This role is for someone who wants to work at the intersection of film, television, and AI. The AI part is the day\-to\-day — Python, ComfyUI, model evaluation. The film and television part is
 *why* 
 it matters. If you're a strong engineer who watches a movie and wonders how the shot was built, or who's been hacking on generative video tools in your spare time because you find the medium genuinely interesting, you'll fit here.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Help build and extend the agentic pipeline — orchestration logic in Python, ComfyUI workflow integration, prompt assembly, state management, take evaluation
* Run and benchmark open\-weight video models (LTX 2\.3, Wan, HunyuanVideo, Mochi, CogVideoX, Open\-Sora, and whatever drops next) on our local Blackwell 6000 — document what works, what fits in VRAM, what's worth pursuing
* Build the smaller tooling around the pipeline: dataset prep scripts, evaluation harnesses, batch runners, debugging utilities
* Test pipelines end\-to\-end on real in\-house source material for short\-form generation experiments
* Document findings in a way the team (and future students) can build on
* Contribute to IRAP reporting deliverables: what we tried, what we learned, what we shipped



 What we're looking for
 



**You should have** 



* A degree (or be finishing one) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field — recent grads and final\-year students welcome
* Strong Python — you can read someone else's codebase, find your way around it, and add a feature without breaking three other things
* Hands\-on exposure to the modern ML stack: PyTorch, HuggingFace, model checkpoints, basic CUDA awareness
* Comfort on the command line — Linux, Git, debugging environment issues
* Self\-direction. The TD is here two days a week. You'll need to make progress between check\-ins and flag blockers early



**Bonus points for** 



* Prior experience with ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion / Flux, or any open\-weight video model
* A side project involving generative AI, video, or creative tools — even rough, even unfinished
* Curiosity about film, VFX, or storytelling — you don't need a film background, but you should care about what the output actually looks like
* Familiarity with Ollama or local LLM serving
* FFmpeg fluency



**You don't need** 



* Production VFX experience
* A graduate degree
* Five years of anything



 What you'll learn
 


* How a real AI production pipeline gets built, from research paper to shipping system
* Working with frontier open\-weight models on serious local hardware (most students don't get to touch a 96GB GPU until they're well into industry)
* How to evaluate AI systems against real\-world production constraints, not just benchmarks
* Direct mentorship from a senior Technical Director with deep VFX and AI pipeline experience
* The full agentic AI stack: LLM orchestration, multi\-modal model coordination, prompt engineering, evaluation, assembly



 Eligibility (IRAP\-funded position)
 



 This role is funded through the NRC Industrial Research Assistance Program (IRAP). To be eligible, you must:
 


* Be a Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or person with refugee status
* Be legally entitled to work in Canada
* Meet the NRC\-IRAP youth/recent\-graduate eligibility criteria
* Local Toronto



 Engagement

 : Toronto\-based, hybrid arrangement workable
* **Start date** 
 : As soon as a strong candidate lands
* **Compensation** 
 :

 Send a short note \+ GitHub / portfolio link to

Toboggan Labs est une firme\-conseil boutique qui œuvre à l'intersection de l'IA et de la santé. Nous résolvons des problèmes humains complexes en appliquant des technologies de pointe combinées à une solide compréhension du domaine.


**À propos du poste**



Nous sommes à la recherche



Veuillez noter que, bien que nous soyons spécialisés dans le secteur de la santé et les industries réglementées, tous nos projets ne relèvent pas de ces domaines. Vous pourriez donc être amené·e à travailler sur des projets variés dans différents secteurs, selon les besoins.  

  

**Vos responsabilités quotidiennes**


* Travail client facturable (environ 50 % du temps), qui peut inclure :
* + Agir en tant que responsable technique et architecte au sein des équipes de projet client, travailler en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les chefs de projet, les concepteurs de produits, les développeurs de logiciels et les équipes généralement interdisciplinaires ; dans ces missions, vous devrez être pratique.
	+ Travail pratique en solo — par exemple, effectuer des recherches consultatives pour les clients, créer des preuves de concept, contribuer occasionnellement à du code prêt pour la production pour les clients et les projets internes.
* Travailler avec notre équipe de vente et de développement commercial pour développer l'entreprise en menant des discussions techniques dans les cycles de vente, en contribuant aux supports marketing et en participant à des événements.
* Travailler avec le développement commercial et le marketing pour articuler la vision et les réalisations de l'entreprise en ce qui concerne l'IA et la science des données ; contribuer à la documentation écrite, participer à des événements et représenter l'entreprise de toute autre manière.
* Encadrer les membres les plus expérimentés de notre équipe technique et fournir des conseils à notre guilde de pratique de l'IA.
* Diriger des groupes de travail internes sur les pratiques et les normes de l'IA et de la science des données à déployer dans le cadre de nos projets ; collaborer avec d'autres data scientists et ingénieurs IA seniors pour garantir la qualité de la livraison du projet.
* Collaborer avec la direction du développement et de la conception de logiciels pour identifier les opportunités pour nos équipes d'IA de créer un effet de levier supplémentaire, par exemple via des projets internes et de nouveaux services.


**À propos de vous**



Nous recherchons un leader technique chevronné qui aime résoudre les problèmes commerciaux avec l'IA. Vous aimez comprendre la technologie la plus avancée, tout en restant pragmatique quant à ses applications raisonnables. Il s'agit d'un rôle de contributeur individuel, mais nous attendons de vous que vous ayez un impact sur les équipes et que vous soyez capable de diriger des projets. Il s'agit également, et c'est crucial, d'un rôle très orienté vers l'extérieur.


**Nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous :**


* Posséder plus de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle.
* Avoir de l'expérience avec Python et les plateformes d'infonuagique.
* Avoir une solide compréhension des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique et de l'apprentissage profond, plus particulièrement des modèles d'IA générative.
* Avoir de l'expérience dans la conception et le déploiement de pipelines d'apprentissage automatique à l'aide de technologies infonuagiques.
* Avoir une bonne connaissance des environnements de calcul distribué et des technologies de mégadonnées.
* Maîtriser les bonnes pratiques en développement logiciel ainsi que les systèmes de contrôle de version (p. ex. Git).
* Détenir une maîtrise.
* Avoir occupé des rôles en contact direct avec les clients, notamment en consultation.


**Atouts supplémentaires**


* Une exposition au secteur de la santé (p. ex. opérations cliniques, dispositifs médicaux, pharmaceutique, etc.) constitue un atout, puisque la santé est notre principal domaine d'intervention, sans être une exigence.


Toutes nos offres d'emploi décrivent un peu une licorne. Si vous êtes plutôt un « narval », postulez quand même ! Il n'est pas nécessaire de répondre à toutes les exigences, ni aux critères bonis. L'expérience et les compétences sont importantes, mais le potentiel de croissance et l'attitude le sont tout autant. Nous sommes généralement flexibles quant aux niveaux ou pouvons vous orienter vers une offre plus appropriée lorsqu'elle sera ouverte.


**Ce que nous offrons**



Nous sommes une entreprise en télétravail d'abord, avec un espace de bureau à Montréal. Nous privilégions l'embauche au Québec, mais sommes ouverts aux candidatures partout au Canada dans les fuseaux horaires EST ±2\.



Toboggan Labs valorise la diversité des personnes qu'elle embauche et qu'elle sert. Pour nous, la diversité signifie créer un milieu de travail où les différences de chacun·e sont reconnues, appréciées, respectées et prises en compte afin de développer et de mettre à profit les talents et les forces de chaque personne.

**Principal Consultant / Head of AI**


**About Us**



Toboggan Labs is a boutique consultancy building at the intersection of AI and healthcare. We solve challenging human problems by applying cutting\-edge technology and domain understanding.

This is a director\-level position with both external, client\-facing, and internal responsibilities. In this role, you will be the most senior technical leader for our overall AI and data science practice, and set and represent the company's technical vision as pertains to AI. You will spend the majority of your time working with clients, whether as part of a team or independently. You will also spend a significant portion of your time participating in sales cycles and representing the company at events (conferences, etc).

* Billable client work (\~50% of the time), which might include:
* Serving as technical lead and architect on client project teams, working closely with clients, project managers, product designers, software developers, and generally interdisciplinary teams — in these engagements, you will be expected to be hands\-on.
* Solo hands\-on work — e.g. doing advisory research for clients, creating proofs\-of\-concept, occasionally contributing production\-ready code to client and internal projects.
* Working with our sales and business development team to grow the business by leading technical discussions in sales cycles, contributing to marketing materials, and attending events.
* Working with business development and marketing to articulate the company's vision and achievements as pertains to AI and data science; contributing to written materials, participating in events, and otherwise representing the company.

* Leading internal working groups on AI and data science practices and standards to be deployed across our projects; collaborating with other senior data scientists and AI engineers to ensure the quality of project delivery.

**About you**



We are seeking a seasoned technical leader who loves solving business problems with AI. You thrive on understanding the most cutting edge technology — while still being pragmatic about its reasonable applications.



This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to have impact across teams and be able to lead projects. This is also, crucially, a very external\-facing role.


**We want you to apply if you:**


* Have a proven track record of technical leadership.
* Have broad experience in data science and AI, across multiple different subfields (e.g. from NLP to computer vision).
* Have a strong sense of the economics and business value of AI solutions.
* Have an academic background in AI or a related field.
* Have 8\+ years of overall experience as a technology professional, ideally across different types of roles (e.g. research, applied research, product).
* Have exceptional leadership and communication skills.
* Have strong French language presentation, technical and interpersonal skills and the ability to work comfortably with American clients.


**Bonus points if you:**


* We would love for you to have some exposure to healthcare (clinical operations, medical devices, pharma, etc.), since that is our primary area of focus.


We typically hire generalists. In this role, we are expecting you to be primarily an AI and data science specialist but have a strong interest in helping generalists learn about AI and an affinity for adjacent domains — namely design and engineering.



All of our job postings describe a bit of a unicorn. If you're kind of a "narwhal," please apply anyway. You don't need to meet all the requirements, let alone the bonus criteria. While experience and skill sets are valuable, growth potential and attitudes are equally important. We are usually flexible on levels or can advise you when a more relevant posting opens.


**What we offer**



We are a remote\-first company with office space in Montreal. We prefer to hire in Quebec, but we are open to candidates anywhere in the EST±2 time zone in Canada.



Toboggan Labs values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity, for us, means fostering a workplace in which a person's differences are recognized, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize their talents and strengths.  

  

In addition:


* Home office/technology budget;
* Yearly professional development budget;
* Company matching RRSP after 1 year;
* From Day 1
* + 100% employer\-paid health \& dental insurance including a yearly bank of coverage for complementary medicine (Acupuncture, osteopathy, massage therapy, naturopathy, psychology, etc.);
	+ Life, long \& short\-term disability insurance;
* Parental leave top\-up (8 weeks), available to employees with 1\+ year of tenure, regardless of path to parenthood.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer
description:
***Build the AI backbone of a fast\-growing Australian business 🚀***




  





 📍 Zetland, Sydney · Full\-time (4 days office, 1 day WFH)
 



 💰 $70k–$75k base \+ super
 



 🧠 First dev hire — high ownership, direct line to the founder
 



  





 We're hiring our first in\-house developer — and we want someone who treats AI as a power tool, not a sidekick.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to be the first developer at Hire A Mover, working directly with the founder to design and ship the AI\-driven systems that will run a fast\-growing business. You won't be one engineer of fifty. You'll be the one engineer — with a blank canvas, real autonomy, and your work running the business from day one.
 



  




 About Hire A Mover
 
 We're the contents handling specialist that insurance builders and restoration companies rely on across Australia — packing, moving and storing contents through the claims process. We also run a national B2C removals, packing, boxes and storage business across NSW, VIC, QLD, SA and WA.
 



  





 The business has doubled in the past year and we're not slowing down.
 



  




 What you'll build
 
 We're consolidating and modernising our backend — fewer systems, smarter workflows, AI woven through everything. Quoting, bookings, scheduling, client portals, invoicing, fuel and toll costing, customer comms — all of it streamlined.
 



  





 Exactly what shape that takes — one big platform, several integrated systems, or somewhere in between — is what we'll figure out as we build. We'd rather hire someone who's excited by that than pretend we have it all designed already.
 



  





 Alongside the backend build, our public websites stay as WordPress and keep evolving — Hire A Mover, Hire A Packer and Hire A Box. They're our shopfront, they're growing with us, and they need ongoing technical, SEO and design work.
 



  





 Three streams of work:
 



 •      
 **The new backend —** 
 designing and shipping our AI\-driven operating system. Quoting, bookings, scheduling, client portals, invoicing, plus integrations with Xero, GPS tracking, SMS and email. Replaces our existing CodeIgniter CRM function by function.
 



 •      
 **Public websites —** 
 ongoing. Technical changes, SEO, page builds, conversion improvements. You'll brief and work alongside our UX designers, translating designs into production\-ready code. This stream is permanent, not transitional.
 



 •      
 **Existing CodeIgniter CRM —** 
 light\-touch maintenance until each function gets absorbed by the new backend.
 



  




 What we care about 🔥
 
 We care more about intelligence, initiative, curiosity and speed of learning than years of experience or specific frameworks.
 



  





 You might be:
 



 •      A recent CS or software engineering grad
 



 •      A strong self\-taught developer
 



 •      Someone already building serious side projects
 



 •      1–2 years into your first dev role
 



  





 What matters most:
 



 •      You build with AI as your primary tool, not as a sidekick. You've shipped real things with Claude, Cursor, or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. You think in prompts and pipelines as naturally as you think in functions and loops.
 



 •      You're a builder, not a ticket\-closer. You'd rather ship something useful than spend a week in a Jira queue.
 



 •      You're comfortable with ambiguity. The backend isn't fully designed yet — we want someone excited to help shape it, not someone who needs the spec handed to them.
 



  





**Bonus, not required:** 
 experience with PHP, CodeIgniter, WordPress, marketing automation, SEO, or analytics.
 



  




 You'll thrive here if you
 
 •      Love building real things that get used immediately
 



 •      Want exposure to AI, product, business and growth — not just code
 



 •      Prefer momentum over bureaucracy
 



 •      Want to become dangerously capable in your 20s
 



 •      Use AI tools constantly to move faster
 



  




 What's different about this role 🌟
 
 •      First dev hire — blank canvas, your work runs the business
 



 •      Real autonomy on what gets built — AI woven through everything
 



 •      Direct line to the founder. No layers, no committee
 



 •      Genuine variety — backend AI build, public websites, SEO, UX collab, all in one job
 



 •      Zetland office — fun shared workspace, pool table, snacks and drinks, dog\-friendly
 



 •      Work from home one day a week
 



 •      Half\-day off on your birthday
 



 •      $70k–$75k base \+ super
 



  




 Important
 
 This is a primarily in\-office role in Zetland — 4 days in the office, 1 day from home. We strongly believe smart people working together in person learn, collaborate and execute dramatically faster.
 



  





 You'll need full Australian work rights.
 



  




 To apply
 
 We care more about proof of curiosity and capability than polished corporate resumes. We're using a TestGorilla assessment to keep it fair and remove unconscious bias:
 



  





 https://app.testgorilla.com/s/098kpj9o
 



  




* Successful candidates will be invited to interview.

**Benefits:** 




  





 At ELMO you will be joining an epic team with the opportunity to make a big impact. We foster an authentic, collaborative, fun working environment and being an ELMOnian means you're part of an amazing team that will push you to grow, support you with challenges and allow you to shine.
 



 Some of our benefits include:

**Our Values:**

 – Everything we do is designed to positively impact our customers.

 \- Be they colleagues, communities or customers, we champion ways to help others thrive.

 As the Lead AI Engineer, you will will spearhead the development and deployment of cutting\-edge AI solutions that power intelligent automation across ELMO’s core HR platform. * **Lead AI Architecture** 
 : You will design and implement enterprise\-scale AI systems, driving technical architecture and system design decisions for AI\-native applications.

 : You will design, deploy, and build agentic AI workflows for complex HR scenarios using Large Language Models, RAG architectures, and multi\-agent systems. This includes creating real\-time AI processing pipelines and developing AI\-powered integrations with more than 50 SaaS platforms.

 : You will lead a growing AI team of ML/AI engineers and automation specialists, mentoring and developing junior engineers, and contributing to the growth of an AI center of excellence. You'll also drive technical decisions that will influence the company's AI strategy for years to come.

 : You will focus on business outcomes, such as reducing customer onboarding time from weeks to hours through intelligent automation, enhancing SaaS integrations with AI\-powered data mapping, and enabling predictive HR analytics.

You will also design APIs and SDKs that empower customers to build their own AI\-enhanced workflows.

* Has expert technical knowledge and is ready and willing to share learning and experiences with others to be more effective in their roles.

* Able to communicate technical concepts confidently and clearly.

* Teamwork and Contribution to deliver on project.
* Process.
* Design, implement and maintain secure, stable and cost\-effective infrastructure to our platform.
* Understanding of project requirements and implementation.

* Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree with a concentration in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience of minimum of three years.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML engineering experience with 3\+ years in leadership roles
* Deep expertise in Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock)
* Production experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar)
* Strong background in MLOps and AI system architecture at scale
* Proficiency in Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and modern ML engineering tools
* Follow industry best practices.
* Well\-developed communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.



  





  





 ELMO Software Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to join our team. We are also committed to advancing reconciliation at ELMO through our Reflect Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP) .
 



  





 At ELMO, we are passionate about empowering HR with responsible, secure and safe AI, aiming to be among the first in Australia and New Zealand to achieve ISO 42001:2023 certification. Handling sensitive employee data necessitates strict adherence to our ISO 27001:2022 Certified security policies, making data privacy and security paramount in every role.
